content.text: For Designers — How Tokens Map to the UI

inlineContent.text: The five token categories map directly to the visual properties a designer controls in a design tool:
Every colour used in the UI — backgrounds, text, borders, icons
Font family, weight, size, line height, and letter-spacing for each text role
Padding and gap values between elements
Corner rounding of buttons, cards, and input fields
Fixed dimensions — button heights, icon sizes, input cell dimensions
